status_summary: FDA-approved as Egrifta for HIV lipodystrophy only. A biologic since 2020, so not eligible for compounding.

what_happens_next: HHS's draft "Enforcement Discretion Policy Regarding 503A Compounding Using Certain Peptide Bulk Drug Substances" (FR Doc. 2026-22192, Docket HHS-OASH-2026-0496) went on public inspection Oct 28, 2026 and is scheduled for Federal Register publication Oct 30, 2026.
